label: Owner decision 2026-11-06: pin witnesses on lumen naturale and try to close bridge
summary: Owner decision 2026-11-06: pin witnesses on lumen naturale and try to close bridge (b). Pinned and read: Rom 1-2 (Nova Vulgata, vatican.va), Augustine De civitate Dei VIII (The Latin Library), Justin Second Apology (First1KGreek, git), Aquinas ST I-II q.91 a.2 (Corpus Thomisticum); reused the pinned SCTA q.94 a.4. Seven stating claims, each on what its text states: Rom 1:19-21 (outsiders knew God through the things made, without excuse), Rom 2:14-15 (gentiles know the law by nature), Justin (seed of the logos in every race; writers saw dimly), Augustine VIII.6 (Platonists reached the first principle by reasoning; Rom 1:20 applied to them), Aquinas q.91 a.2 (natural light as impression of the divine light; gentiles have natural law) and q.94 a.4 (common principles equally known to all; the article does not classify God's existence). All support bridge (b) with gap notes. None is recorded as an attack on the theological-horizon reply: non-Christian or idolatrous knowers are outside Christianity, not shown to be outside every theological horizon (a further, unrecorded bridge). Result: bridge (b) is better supported but not closed: no text states it in the bridge's form, several speak of practical reason or of God's showing, and closing under #999 would require establishing it, i.e. refuting the horizon reply from established premises. To compare A/B require explicit links from those standards to OwnStandard and Correct, plus a link from authority to AnswersToSharedReason before inferring sharedness or its denial.
